payload.purpose_context: Durable artifacts keep citing bare commit SHAs and line ranges that the mission lifecycle's own rebases and compaction leave dangling, squad briefs declare blockers resolved without reproducing them, the anti-AI-prose rules reach only internal reports, and the common-docs styleguide still teaches the path-string audience and related shapes that doc-kitty rejects. This mission states the stable-identifier and content-anchored citation rules once in the writing pack's citation styleguide, adds reproduce-before-resolved and reachability-before-ruling steps to the squad procedure, ships a shared AI-writing-tells styleguide that internal report writing references, and rewrites the common-docs guidance around doc-kitty's frontmatter with neutral examples.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give writers one citable rule for citations that survive history rewrites, one shared list of AI-prose tells, and doc-kitty frontmatter as the docs default.
